<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>LearnNova | Your Learning Space</title>

<style>
/* BASIC SETTINGS */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    background: #080b18;
    color: white;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* BACKGROUND GLOW */
body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    width: 500px;
    height: 500px;
    background: #673cff;
    filter: blur(180px);
    opacity: 0.22;
    top: -150px;
    left: -150px;
    z-index: -1;
    pointer-events: none;
}

body::after {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    width: 400px;
    height: 400px;
    background: #00d9ff;
    filter: blur(180px);
    opacity: 0.13;
    right: -150px;
    bottom: -100px;
    z-index: -1;
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* NAVIGATION */
nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 22px 8%;
    background: rgba(8, 11, 24, 0.8);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
}

.logo {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a78bfa, #22d3ee);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
}

nav a {
    color: #cbd5e1;
    text-decoration: none;
    margin-left: 25px;
    font-size: 14px;
    transition: 0.3s;
}

nav a:hover {
    color: #22d3ee;
}

/* HERO SECTION */
.hero {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 100px 20px 70px;
}

.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    border: 1px solid #5141a8;
    background: rgba(103, 60, 255, 0.12);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    border-radius: 30px;
    padding: 9px 18px;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(40px, 7vw, 76px);
    line-height: 1.12;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -2px;
}

.gradient-text {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a78bfa, #22d3ee);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
}

.hero p {
    color: #9ca3b8;
    max-width: 600px;
    margin: 24px auto;
    line-height: 1.8;
    font-size: 16px;
}

.button {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 14px 26px;
    margin: 10px 5px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7048ff, #4f9cff);
    color: white;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: bold;
    transition: 0.3s;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 35px #7048ff55;
}

.button-outline {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid #343b58;
}

/* STATISTICS */
.stats {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 60px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 35px 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid #20243a;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #20243a;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.015);
}

.stat h2 {
    font-size: 30px;
    color: #a78bfa;
    text-align: center;
}

.stat p {
    color: #8992a9;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-top: 7px;
}

/* GENERAL SECTIONS */
section {
    padding: 80px 8%;
}

.section-title {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 38px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.section-description {
    text-align: center;
    color: #8e97ad;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    line-height: 1.7;
}

/* SEARCH */
.search-box {
    max-width: 500px;
    margin: 0 auto 35px;
}

.search-box input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #303651;
    background: #11162a;
    color: white;
    outline: none;
    font-size: 15px;
}

.search-box input:focus {
    border-color: #8b5cf6;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px #8b5cf633;
}

/* SUBJECT CARDS */
.grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 22px;
}

.card {
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #151a30, #0d1122);
    border: 1px solid #272d48;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px;
    transition: 0.3s;
}

.card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    border-color: #8063ff;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 40px #00000044;
}

.card-icon {
    font-size: 35px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.card h3 {
    font-size: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.card p {
    color: #929bb0;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.card a {
    color: #a78bfa;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.card a:hover {
    color: #22d3ee;
}

/* FEATURE BANNER */
.banner {
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, #332078, #133c61);
    border: 1px solid #6552a8;
    border-radius: 25px;
    padding: 45px;
    text-align: center;
}

.banner h2 {
    font-size: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.banner p {
    color: #d0d5ed;
    line-height: 1.8;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

/* FOOTER */
footer {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 35px 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid #20243a;
    color: #79839b;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 2;
}

footer span {
    color: #a78bfa;
}

/* MOBILE RESPONSIVENESS */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    nav {
        padding: 18px 5%;
    }

    nav a {
        margin-left: 10px;
        font-size: 12px;
    }

    .logo {
        font-size: 20px;
    }

    .hero {
        padding-top: 75px;
    }

    .stats {
        gap: 30px;
    }

    section {
        padding: 60px 5%;
    }

    .banner {
        padding: 30px 20px;
    }
}

/* WHITEBOARD SECTION */
#whiteboard { display:none; padding-top:45px; }
.whiteboard-shell { max-width:1400px; margin:0 auto; background:#0d1122; border:1px solid #303651; border-radius:20px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 15px 40px #00000044; }
.whiteboard-heading { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0 0 16px; }
.whiteboard-heading h2 { font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,34px); }
.whiteboard-heading p { color:#9ca3b8; margin-top:6px; line-height:1.5; }
#whiteboardFrame { display:block; width:100%; height:1200px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:#eef2f8; }
@media (max-width:600px) { .whiteboard-shell {padding:8px;} #whiteboardFrame {height:1500px;} }

</style>
</head>

<body>

<!-- NAVIGATION -->
<nav>
    <div class="logo">✦ LearnNova</div>

    <div>
        <a href="#home">Home</a>
        <a href="#subjects">Subjects</a>
        <a href="#about">About</a>
        <a href="#whiteboard" id="whiteboardNavLink">Whiteboard</a>
    </div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<header class="hero" id="home">

    <div class="badge">🚀 YOUR JOURNEY STARTS HERE</div>

    <h1>
        Learn More.<br>
        <span class="gradient-text">Dream Bigger.</span>
    </h1>

    <p>
        Welcome to your personal learning universe.
        Explore subjects, discover new ideas, and build
        the skills that will shape your future.
    </p>

    <a href="#subjects" class="button">Explore Subjects →</a>

    <a href="#about" class="button button-outline">Discover More</a>
    <a href="#whiteboard" class="button" id="openWhiteboardButton">🖊️ Open Whiteboard</a>

</header>

<!-- STATISTICS -->
<div class="stats">

    <div class="stat">
        <h2>∞</h2>
        <p>Possibilities</p>
    </div>

    <div class="stat">
        <h2>01</h2>
        <p>Your Learning Journey</p>
    </div>

    <div class="stat">
        <h2>24/7</h2>
        <p>Explore Anytime</p>
    </div>

</div>

<!-- SUBJECTS -->
<section id="subjects">

    <h2 class="section-title">
        Explore <span class="gradient-text">Subjects</span>
    </h2>

    <p class="section-description">
        Find something interesting and start learning today.
    </p>

    <div class="search-box">
        <input
            type="text"
            id="search"
            placeholder="🔍 Search subjects..."
            aria-label="Search subjects"
        >
    </div>

    <div class="grid" id="subjectGrid">

        <div class="card" data-search="mathematics maths numbers">
            <div class="card-icon">📐</div>
            <h3>Mathematics</h3>
            <p>Explore numbers, equations, geometry, and logical thinking.</p>
            <a href="https://www.khanacademy.org/math" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Start Learning →
            </a>
        </div>

        <div class="card" data-search="science physics chemistry biology">
            <div class="card-icon">🔬</div>
            <h3>Science</h3>
            <p>Discover the universe through experiments and scientific ideas.</p>
            <a href="https://www.khanacademy.org/science" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Start Learning →
            </a>
        </div>

        <div class="card" data-search="coding programming computer technology">
            <div class="card-icon">💻</div>
            <h3>Coding</h3>
            <p>Learn programming and create your own websites and projects.</p>
            <a href="https://www.w3schools.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Start Learning →
            </a>
        </div>

        <div class="card" data-search="english grammar writing language">
            <div class="card-icon">📚</div>
            <h3>English</h3>
            <p>Improve grammar, vocabulary, reading, and writing skills.</p>
            <a href="https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Start Learning →
            </a>
        </div>

        <div class="card" data-search="geography history social studies">
            <div class="card-icon">🌍</div>
            <h3>Social Studies</h3>
            <p>Explore history, geography, cultures, and our changing world.</p>
            <a href="https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Start Learning →
            </a>
        </div>

        <div class="card" data-search="general knowledge facts quiz">
            <div class="card-icon">🧠</div>
            <h3>General Knowledge</h3>
            <p>Discover interesting facts and expand your knowledge every day.</p>
            <a href="https://www.britannica.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                Start Learning →
            </a>
        </div>

    </div>

    <p id="noResults" style="display:none;text-align:center;color:#9ca3b8;margin-top:25px;">
        No subjects found. Try another search!
    </p>

</section>


<!-- INTERACTIVE WHITEBOARD -->
<section id="whiteboard">
  <div class="whiteboard-shell">
    <div class="whiteboard-heading">
      <div><h2>🖊️ LearnNova <span class="gradient-text">Whiteboard</span></h2>
      <p>Write, draw, highlight, add shapes, and save your notes.</p></div>
      <button type="button" class="button button-outline" id="closeWhiteboardButton">← Back to Home</button>
    </div>
    <iframe id="whiteboardFrame" title="LearnNova Interactive Whiteboard" loading="lazy"
      allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write"></iframe>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">

    <div class="banner">

        <h2>✨ Your Future Starts With Learning</h2>

        <p>
            Every expert was once a beginner.
            Keep exploring, stay curious, and never stop growing.
        </p>

        <a href="#subjects" class="button">Start Exploring →</a>

    </div>

</section>

<!-- FOOTER -->
<footer>
    <p>Made with <span>♥</span> and curiosity.</p>
    <p>© <span id="year"></span> LearnNova. Keep Learning. Keep Growing.</p>
</footer>

<script>
// SUBJECT SEARCH
const searchInput = document.getElementById("search");
const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".card");
const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");

searchInput.addEventListener("input", function () {

    const query = this.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    let visibleCards = 0;

    cards.forEach(function (card) {

        const searchableText =
            card.innerText.toLowerCase() + " " +
            card.dataset.search.toLowerCase();

        const matches = searchableText.includes(query);

        card.style.display = matches ? "block" : "none";

        if (matches) {
            visibleCards++;
        }

    });

    noResults.style.display =
        visibleCards === 0 ? "block" : "none";

});

// AUTOMATIC COPYRIGHT YEAR
document.getElementById("year").textContent =
    new Date().getFullYear();

// OPEN/CLOSE THE EMBEDDED WHITEBOARD
(function () {
  const section = document.getElementById("whiteboard");
  const frame = document.getElementById("whiteboardFrame");
  let loaded = false;
  function openBoard(event) {
    if (event) event.preventDefault();
    section.style.display = "block";
    if (!loaded) {
      const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(""), ch => ch.charCodeAt(0));
      frame.srcdoc = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes);
      loaded = true;
    }
    section.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"start"});
  }
  function closeBoard(event) {
    if (event) event.preventDefault();
    section.style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("home").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"start"});
    if (location.hash === "#whiteboard") history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search);
  }
  document.getElementById("openWhiteboardButton").addEventListener("click", openBoard);
  document.getElementById("whiteboardNavLink").addEventListener("click", openBoard);
  document.getElementById("closeWhiteboardButton").addEventListener("click", closeBoard);
})();

</script>

</body>
</html>
